stratagems.name: Watched
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DARK ANGELS DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack against a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Deathwing Assault
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One DARK ANGELS DEATHWING unit from your army arriving from Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 3" horizontally from all enemy models.

stratagems.name: Righteous Repugnance
stratagems.target: One DARK ANGELS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Intractable Will
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DARK ANGELS unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
